 Reacher has long been considered Prime Video's biggest streaming hit, but it may have met its match. Chris Pratt's The Terminal List has outperformed Reacher on the streaming charts ever since it finally returned for its second season after four years away.

 The Terminal List is way out of Reacher on IMDb's list of popular television shows. The Terminal List ranks No. 9, while Reacher is No. 49. Since its return, The Terminal List has also consistently outperformed Reacher on the streaming charts. Reacher is currently No. 3 on Prime Video worldwide. Reacher is No. 9, per FlixPatrol.
 The Terminal List Beats Reacher at Its Own Game
 Chris Pratt in  The Terminal List Image via Marni Grossman/Prime 
 The Terminal List fans waited four years for a new season (though they did have the prequel series The Terminal List: Dark Wolf to tide them over) and are apparently very into these new episodes. The Terminal List Season 2 transforms the series from a psychological revenge thriller into a globe-trotting espionage adventure. The story takes Reece across the Indian Ocean, Southern and Northern Africa, the Middle East, and Europe as he uncovers a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley and ties into his own family's history.
 There's also been more good news for fans of The Terminal List . Pratt will return as James Reece in a new series, Savage Son , based on the third book in Jack Carr's Terminal List series. It's unclear whether Savage Son will count as the third season of The Terminal List or be a standalone series like Dark Wolf , and Prime Video hasn't confirmed any other cast, new or returning.
 The Terminal List franchise has garnered more than 100 million viewers worldwide, according to Amazon. That includes views of The Terminal List: Dark Wolf .
 Reacher Continues to Expand Its Franchise Footprint
 Image via Prime Video 
 Prime Video has confirmed Reacher's future. Amazon's streaming service renewed the Reacher spinoff Neagley just weeks after it debuted to 40 million viewers in its first 13 days, per Amazon, making it the fourth-most-viewed premiere of a Prime Video original series ever. Prime Video also gave Reacher an early Season 6 renewal , with Season 5 still in production. Nielsen reports that Reacher garnered 1.18 billion minutes viewed in September , following its Season 4 debut.
 " Reacher hits hard." said Peter Friedlander, Head of Global Television, Amazon MGM Studios, in the Reacher Season 6 renewal announcement. "What Lee Child has built and Nick Santora and his creative teams have brought to life is, simply, incredible. Alan Ritchson is Jack Reacher — he's delivered a performance that has captivated audiences around the world. Together with our partners at Paramount Television Studios, we couldn't be more excited to continue this journey. Reacher is a truly iconic series, and we're thrilled to be on the ride with this extraordinary cast and crew for Season Six."
 All episodes of The Terminal List , The Terminal List: Dark Wolf , Reacher , and Neagley are streaming on Prime Video.
